Package fr.cytech.safeexit.model.sector

Class PanelMessage

java.lang.Object
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.sector.PanelMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class PanelMessage extends Object implements Serializable
Instruction displayed on a physical sector panel.

Immutable value object: once created, a message never changes. A panel switches instruction by broadcasting a new PanelMessage. The static factory methods build the standard messages used by the system (standby, alert, evacuation...), so callers never have to remember which PanelMode goes with which text.

  • Constructor Details

    • PanelMessage

      public PanelMessage(String text, PanelMessage.ArrowDirection direction, PanelMode mode)
      Creates a panel message. Null arguments are replaced by safe defaults so a panel can never end up showing null.
      Parameters:
      text - the line of text to display
      direction - the arrow to draw
      mode - the mode (and therefore the colour code) of the message
